LanguageData.Epinephrine.label: epinephrine autoinjector
LanguageData.Epinephrine.description: Injects adrenaline to temporarily boost movement, reduce pain and support shock treatment. Does not replace lost blood; excessive doses risk heart attack or stroke.
LanguageData.Ketamine.label: ketamine autoinjector
LanguageData.Ketamine.description: Autoinjector for pain relief and rapid sedation. Repeated doses can cause dangerous drug buildup and overdose.
LanguageData.Morphine.label: morphine autoinjector
LanguageData.Morphine.description: Rapid pain relief. Suppresses breathing and circulation, making it dangerous during blood loss or resuscitation. Avoid combining with other depressants such as alcohol.
LanguageData.Chloroform.label: chloroform-soaked cloth
LanguageData.Chloroform.description: Sedates a patient. Difficult to dose safely; excessive use risks organ damage, respiratory failure and cardiac arrest.
